attempt: Assign HitboxType Empty to non-solid foliage and compare absent server effects directly with protocol effects; treat a zero server exit code as QA success.
reason_failed: Hytale 0.7.2 has no BlockBoundingBoxes asset named Empty. Material Empty is separate from the selection hitbox. An absent/empty effect becomes the protocol default [None], so direct empty-array equality fails. The helper shuts down the server normally after an exception, yielding exit code zero without a new success report.

conditions: Custom foliage block uses a nonexistent built-in hitbox name
